summary: A Sharjah dental clinic with 15 years of experience appears to lose new patients to a free builder footer, a gmail contact and no online booking or WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free SITE123 address, with a footer that says I BUILT MY SITE FOR FREE USING SITE123.
findings.cost: A free builder footer looks temporary for a clinic with over 5000 patients.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a branded footer.

findings.problem: The contact appears to be a gmail address and one landline.
findings.cost: A free email gives less trust, and patients who want a quick answer have nothing faster than a call.
findings.fix: A clinic email on your own domain.

findings.problem: No online booking and no WhatsApp appear on the page.
findings.cost: Patients who want to book after hours cannot, and they book with a clinic that lets them.
findings.fix: Online booking on the page and a one tap WhatsApp button.
